title: Python ETL for Power BI
subtitle: Replace Power Query with pandas. SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

lessons.title: Why Python ETL Over Power Query
lessons.description: The cases where Python wins: complex transforms, API calls, and repeatability beyond what Power Query can do.

lessons.title: Environment Setup: venv, pip, Jupyter
lessons.description: Set up a clean, isolated Python environment for data work. No Anaconda baggage.

lessons.title: Pandas Crash Course for BI Developers
lessons.description: DataFrames, series, merge, groupby — everything you need coming from a SQL/Power Query background.

lessons.title: Read Excel, CSV, and JSON Files
lessons.description: Load messy files, handle encoding issues, and normalize columns programmatically.

lessons.title: Data Cleaning: nulls, types, duplicates
lessons.description: The cleaning pipeline that runs before any transform. Make it repeatable and testable.

lessons.title: Merging and Reshaping Data
lessons.description: pd.merge, pivot_table, melt — match what you'd do in Power Query but with code you can version.

lessons.title: SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API
lessons.description: Authenticate with Graph API and pull SharePoint list data or Excel files without manual exports.

lessons.title: Write to Power BI via Python Script Visual
lessons.description: Use Python inside Power BI Desktop as a data source and as a visual. Production caveats included.
